profile.headline: Software Engineer - Good Ball Network (Ios/Android) - Looking for Partners & Angel Investors
profile.summary:
The thing that I love most about coding is the feeling I get after solving a problem. For me there is nothing more rewarding than being giving a puzzle and being the one to have that aha moment. My goal is to be a top-notch programmer and become the go to guy for any programming issues plaguing my employer. I want to be well-versed in every proven coding technique/method and be able use that groundwork to become a respected/admired innovator in the technology community.

Portfolio - http://lamp.cse.fau.edu/~jstewa50/jibstewart.me/

•	Managed client databases using PhpMyAdmin
